faqs.answer: Yes. Each work exists once: one serial, one story, one piece. It is never copied, never reissued, and never produced again. After payment confirmation it belongs to one collector only.
faqs.question: Is each Noirven work really one of a kind?

faqs.answer: Every work carries its N+ serial engraved on the inside or the back of the piece, for example N-0535. The serial is the work's identity and appears on its product page.
faqs.question: How is a Noirven work numbered?

faqs.answer: Each available work has a fixed price in USD on its product page under /auctions/{slug}. Payment is made in USDT (BEP-20 on BNB Smart Chain); the back office confirms receipt, then registers the collector as owner and arranges shipping.
faqs.question: How do I buy a Noirven work?

faqs.answer: Noirven presents its one-of-one, numbered jewelry works through seven-day belonging windows on the auctions page. Each work is shown with its serial, story series, materials, craft line, image, ownership status and fixed purchase terms.
faqs.question: What is the seven-day belonging window?

faqs.answer: Pricing is set by gem-grade rarity, craft hours and the unique serial. A rare work goes to one collector's archive, with an emphasis on heritage and long-term value rather than display.
faqs.question: How is the price of a Noirven work set?
